title: Human adjudication of first exhaustive corpus scope
description: A human reviewer must adjudicate the completed easy-school packet without seeing current scanner output during the initial decision. For every record, inspect pinned source context, apply the written taxonomy, and approve, correct, reject, mark ambiguous, or request more context. Confirm that every scanner-relevant component declaration in the declared scope was reviewed and that exclusions are justified. Record reviewer identity and date on every accepted or changed record. Preserve proposed and correction history. Only after exhaustive coverage is confirmed may the scope participate in precision; ambiguous records remain outside headline denominators. Agents may facilitate the worksheet but may not perform the human acceptance.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: PR #5 merged the 150-annotation proposed corpus to develop. This human-adjudication gate is unchanged: agents must not mark records accepted. First exhaustive scope is still easy-school (DATAP-e64aa8, license-blocked) or whichever packet a human actually reviews next.
